claims.claim: Brain Sync exposes a bounded deterministic NEXT proof, rejects competing mirrors, and represents the current unique unauthored BO-2/3 NEXT as TASK_AUTHORING without fabricating a TASK or Unified State.

BrainWorkContext and Flow resolution consume compiled bounded context derived from closed Flow Card, lifecycle, subject and request inputs, without model relevance ranking or default historical spec/lineage hydration.
Control facts remain exact; competing NEXT, subject, source and main bindings fail closed, as do context budgets that cannot hold exact controls.
Elision uses explicit versioned structural rules and bounded class, selector, rule and source-digest provenance.

Pipeline reuse requires complete current source/projection bindings, carries no authority, and preserves compiled output after cache deletion; deletion equivalence and binding movement regressions are implemented.

Budget evaluation follows projection, elision and exact reuse; only supporting detail can receive bounded overflow representation, and decision dependencies require fresh digest-rebound exact expansion.
Regression coverage includes TASK-319 split brain, unique unauthored NEXT, moved bindings, cache deletion, overflow, exact expansion, exact controls and malformed relevance inputs.

The committed implementation changes only the five permitted files, activates CANONICAL_CONTEXT_PIPELINE_V1 and its three compatibility exit contracts, and preserves observation-only authority boundaries.
